name: CG High Court Staff Recruitment (Clerk, Stenographer, Typist, Peon, and district courts)

source.title: 2. Constitutional validity of reservation — Effect of judicial declaration of invalidity — Executive authorities cannot act upon a reservation framework already held unconstitutional, unless protected by a subsequent order of the Supreme Court — Recruitment/ appointment/promotion may proceed subject to the final outcome of proceedings pending before the Supreme Court, with consequential orders expressly made subject thereto.
